dungeons.name: Krao Cave

bosses.name: Ultimate Berk (final boss)
tldr: Wave of Fury is a wide frontal pulse and Stone Swipes is a melee cleave — step out of the telegraphs, no jump needed.
Berk Whirl spins after a short wind-up — that spin is the party's burst window.
Extinction for Eternity at 50% HP is a ~9-second stagger check — hold stagger/stun skills for it or eat a heavy raid-wide hit.

bosses.name: Route minis (optional)
tldr: Two optional mini-bosses guard the route — killing each adds its loot cube to the final clear chest.
Full-clear runs pay more Odyle Energy but cost more time — skip on farm mode.

dungeons.transferNote: This is the ilvl 54 band — first long-term gear, not keeper gear. Roll substats on cheap pieces and save real investment for ilvl 70.

bosses.name: Kromede's Desire (final boss)
tldr: The WHOLE party must be inside the boss room before the pull — latecomers get locked behind the door.
Flame Wall: she flies up and sweeps fire walls across the arena — move to the gaps, don't outrun the wave.
Triple Sweep = two quick slashes then a delayed third, and Slowed Slam is a jump-slam with a slow telegraph — dodge late, not early.
In Conquest, adds station at the sides and fire projectiles from the flanks.

dungeons.name: Abyssal Forge: Ludra

bosses.name: Rahu
tldr: Pink Circle DoT debuff: stand in the marked player's circle to pass it on — three failed passes enrage-wipe the raid.
Area sweep: safe cone is behind the boss; a line AoE follows the sweep, so move behind, then sidestep the line.
Donut rings: stack on the boss to skip the jump check; edge poison puddles punish wide positioning.
50%: four-quadrant split — cluster on the boss, avoid the violet cross, jump the back-swiping lasers. 25%: adds spawn, aim line AoEs into them (a violet DoT applied 3× = wipe).

bosses.name: Ketu
tldr: Vertical lasers sweep the room; the sword-slam creates a ring you must jump, then re-position inside it.
Spirit summon: interrupt before the white triangles complete or the raid takes escalating damage.
Orb colours: red = face the boss, blue = look away, purple = absorb by jumping.
Below 40%: cone AoEs plus Mortal Soul Stones — destroy the stones for the invulnerability buff or the cones one-shot.

bosses.name: Eternal Ludra (final boss)
tldr: Claw slams are jumpable; the red orb must be blocked or invulned — dodging it detonates.
Big donut + blue orbs + tornado gaps + lightning spikes: move through the tornado gap and spread for spikes.
50% — Ludra's Ordeal: a 36-box lightning grid; find the safe box or wipe, then burn in the DPS window.
Arena shrinks and line damage inverts — stand ON the line. 30%: split red/blue sides. 10%: stand only on your colour's platforms.
Enrage: 10-minute timer with a 60-second warning.

dungeons.transferNote: First 10-player Sanctuary raid: 4 attempts/week (spent on entry), final-boss kill credit 1/week, Wednesday reset. Bracelets are the raid-only progression slot.
